title: Benefit of Dual-chamber Pacing With Closed Loop Stimulation (CLS) in Tilt-induced Cardioinhibitory Reflex Syncope
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess whether the Closed Loop Stimulation (CLS) in addition to the DDD pacing is effective in reducing syncopal recurrences. The study hypothesis is that DDD pacing with CLS stimulation is able to prevent syncopal recurrences completely or partially by transforming syncope in pre-syncope.
